name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A segmented control whose thumb slides between segments as the cursor clicks Yearly, then Monthly.
useWhen: Showing a segmented control switching between view modes, time ranges or mutually exclusive options.
Demonstrating a smooth continuous thumb slide between compact segments.
Replacing a radio group where a sliding-thumb metaphor reads better.
avoidWhen: You need content panels that crossfade below the control: use tabs.
Options are sequential numbered steps: use stepper.
You need a full dropdown with a reveal panel: use select.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
